symbols.evidence: The changed PIN guard is in DeliveryEstimator.estimate at DeliveryEstimator.java:20-23.

ShipmentClient sends the address postalCode to POST /api/v1/delivery-estimates at ShipmentClient.java:30-37.
CheckoutService obtains address.postalCode and requests the shipment estimate at CheckoutService.java:50-52.
SagaOrchestrator copies order.address().postalCode into order.confirmed payload at SagaOrchestrator.java:104-112.

contracts.evidence: Shipment OpenAPI declares the endpoint at shipment-service.yaml:10-29 and ShipmentClient calls it at ShipmentClient.java:34.
The schema permits postalCode pattern [0-9]{4,10} at shipment-service.yaml:54-58 while runtime now rejects four- and five-digit values.
Order schema allows four-to-ten digits at order.confirmed.v1.json:19 and shipment listener consumes that field at OrderConfirmedListener.java:27-38.
